fetched_title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems
summary: Analyses 81,390 fixed candidate pools from 16,278 questions and finds judge selection rescues minority correct answers (accuracy 63.82% to 70.82-70.95%). The text states no selection rule can recover an answer when no correct candidate was generated, and all-wrong pools are excluded from the stratified ranking analysis.
authors_bib: Jia-Hao Ji and Sijie Li and Jiabei Cheng
